description: For an infinite cardinal k and a cofinal map g from cf(k) into k.ord, the indexed sum of |g(i)| is k.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.InfiniteSumsAndProducts.cofinal_sum.{u} (k : Cardinal.{u}) (hk : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ k)
  (g : k.ord.cof.ord.ToType → Ordinal.{u}) (hg : ∀ (i : k.ord.cof.ord.ToType), g i < k.ord)
  (hc : ∀ b < k.ord, ∃ i, b ≤ g i) : (Cardinal.sum fun i => (g i).card) = k
